_comment: Universal LEA identifier patterns. IMPORTANT: NCIC_ID and LEID patterns are HEURISTIC APPROXIMATIONS pending official format confirmation from Forseti. These patterns may have false positives/negatives. DO NOT rely on them for hard compliance enforcement until Forseti confirms the exact formats. HART-specific identifiers (HART_CASE_ID, HART_SUBJECT_ID) remain in blocked_categories -- they belong in config/cjis-project-patterns.json where the HART compliance team can supply confirmed regexes. To make this gate project-independent in a new deployment: copy the project overlay template, define your case/subject ID patterns there, and remove your project IDs from blocked_categories once confirmed. Set KEEL_CJIS_OVERLAY_REQUIRED=1 to enforce project overlay presence (fail-closed if missing).

allowlist.description: Phone-like patterns in code (test fixtures, seeds, constants) are not PII -- false positive allowlist
Hex constants (0xXXXXXXXX) are not PII -- common in code for seeds, magic numbers, algorithms
Code seed constants (integer literals for RNG seeding) are not PII
Math constants and algorithmic shifts are not PII
Bit shift operations in algorithms are not PII
Keel project author domain -- strip before scanning to allow marketplace display
matellio.com project domain -- strip before scanning
GHA uses-directive CI version pins are not PII
npm scoped package ref with embedded slash is not PII
Semver version pins are not PII -- digit-only version string is not a domain
RFC 2606 reserved documentation domains never contain real PII
.local TLD is non-routable per RFC 6762 -- test fixtures and dev infrastructure only
npm glob-package deprecated-notice -- maintainer ref in package-lock.json not CJIS data
